inspectionMode: source-only; no setup, install, build, worker or WASM execution
scope: Concrete adaptation contracts for page/navigation work toward founder-requested PDF Expert parity; not parity certification

contracts.observedBehavior: Category groups can collapse and persist collapsed state; search filters name/subtitle/link and deduplicates tools into a results grid.
contracts.reuseBoundary: Adapt real category/search rendering into a scoped tool registry adapter; use JETT document context and capability state to select actions.
improvementsAndRisks: Current code queries global DOM and clones tool cards; contextual availability and selected document must not be inferred from a tool label.
Do not replace the current document or lose review preparation while navigating tools.
fixtureAcceptance: Searching rotate returns one usable action; no duplicate results from multiple categories.
Opening and closing page tools preserves active document, selected page, unsaved review and focus.
Unavailable tools explain the missing engine rather than expose a dead primary action.

contracts.observedBehavior: Thumbnail click toggles selected classes; selected pages drive split output. Helpers parse range groups and even/odd indices.
contracts.reuseBoundary: Reuse parsing and selection behavior as pure page-ID operations; adapt with a controlled selection Set and explicit batch operation plan.
improvementsAndRisks: parseRangeGroups silently skips invalid terms and does not require integer inputs.
DOM CSS classes currently act as selection state; changing render batches must not clear logical selection.
fixtureAcceptance: Select pages1,3,5 then reorder: selection follows original page IDs.
Range1-3,5 resolves exactly to four pages; fractional, malformed and out-of-range terms return errors before any operation.
Keyboard selection and explicit all/none controls produce the same plan as pointer selection.

contracts.observedBehavior: SortableJS uses150ms animation, chosen/ghost/drag classes and opacity changes; originalPageIndex survives ordering; a custom-order input provides another reorder path.
contracts.reuseBoundary: Adapt Sortable integration and original-page identity model into instance-owned JETT organizer state; use explicit reorder commands rather than reading DOM as authority.
improvementsAndRisks: Current onEnd resets opacity but does not itself renumber labels.
Sortable drag alone does not provide sufficient keyboard reorder behavior; document switching must dispose the old instance.
fixtureAcceptance: Reorder3,1,2 updates labels and exported page order while source digest remains unchanged.
Keyboard move up/down and pointer drag produce identical plans.
Rapid reorder followed by switching documents cannot apply to the new document.

contracts.observedBehavior: Duplicate clones a thumbnail and reattaches duplicate/delete handlers; delete refuses removal of the final remaining page.
contracts.reuseBoundary: Reuse controls and final-page guard, with explicit unique instance IDs referencing immutable source-page IDs, plus undo history.
improvementsAndRisks: cloneNode does not clone event listeners; previewInit metadata and preview button can be cloned without their handlers.
Removing nodes directly supplies no durable undo plan.
fixtureAcceptance: Duplicate page2 twice: three separately selectable instances render and preview the same correct source page.
Deleting then undoing restores exact page order and selection.
Deleting the final page is refused without modifying prepared bytes.

contracts.observedBehavior: Preview overlay supports next/previous, Escape, arrow keys, backdrop close and page-count display; Space previews the hovered thumbnail.
contracts.reuseBoundary: Adapt overlay navigation and controls to scoped preview state, immutable source identity and focused rather than hover-only keyboard targeting.
improvementsAndRisks: Global singleton and document keydown handler span every tool.
Async renderPreviewPage has no generation fence; rapid page changes can finish out of order.
Focus trapping/restoration and hover-hidden28px control accessibility require improvement.
fixtureAcceptance: Delay page1 render then request page2: page2 remains visible after both complete.
Escape restores focus to the invoking thumbnail; all controls work without hover.
After duplicate/reorder, preview shows original source page and current organizer position clearly.

contracts.observedBehavior: Creates placeholders for all pages, initial rendering capped at20, default batches8 and two eager batches; progress and batch-complete callbacks accompany lazy observation.
contracts.reuseBoundary: Reuse actual scheduler/placeholder structure behind document-scoped rendering jobs, bounded canvas memory and cancellation tokens.
improvementsAndRisks: Global lazyLoadState is unsuitable for multiple concurrent document previews.
Organizer currently renders all thumbnails sequentially; adopting shared renderer is an improvement, not existing organizer behavior.
fixtureAcceptance: A200-page fixture gives usable first thumbnails before all pages finish.
Scrolling fills placeholders without altering selected page IDs.
Closing organizer releases canvases and prevents late results from appending to a new document.

contracts.observedBehavior: cleanupLazyRendering disconnects observer and clears task maps/eager queue; hidePreview hides modal and restores overflow. Merge owns a Worker with message/error callbacks.
contracts.reuseBoundary: Reuse cleanup entrypoints as adapter lifecycle hooks; add actual in-flight PDF render cancellation and operation worker termination/disposal where required.
improvementsAndRisks: Clearing queues is not proof that in-flight renders or worker computation stopped.
Closing an overlay is not equivalent to canceling a pending export.
fixtureAcceptance: Cancel during thumbnail rendering and during export: no stale UI writes, no replacement download, worker/render resources released.
Cancel restores previous usable review instead of clearing it.
Cancel then immediately start another document cannot receive the old progress or result.

contracts.observedBehavior: Page rotation array drives thumbnail transforms; UI exposes page wrappers and rotation displays; PDF operation copies pages for right angles and embeds page contents for arbitrary angles.
contracts.reuseBoundary: Adapt page selection/rotation feedback; route90-degree changes through JETT native verified rotatePdfPages and an explicit immutable operation plan.
improvementsAndRisks: Array index must not become identity after reorder or duplication.
Arbitrary-angle embedding and fresh-document copying have different preservation semantics from leaf /Rotate.
CSS preview is not evidence that final PDF contains matching native rotation.
fixtureAcceptance: Selected pages1,3 rotate90degrees; page2 remains unchanged after saved-PDF reopen.
Inherited negative Rotate and rotated annotation/form fixtures retain native content and field values.
Undo resets both displayed transforms and operation plan; original bytes remain exact.

contracts.observedBehavior: Organizer reads chosen original indices, copies pages into a new pdf-lib document, saves bytes and downloads under source filename; loader and success/error modals report progress.
contracts.reuseBoundary: Adapt operation execution and progress callbacks to JETT prepare/review/confirm export; derived filename and original custody stay explicit.
improvementsAndRisks: copyPages does not by itself prove retention of document-level fields, outlines or attachments.
Success modal after a download action cannot prove the user saved a file.
Read-only source, signed/protected-document gates and serialized preservation checks must remain.
fixtureAcceptance: Reopened output has exact requested page sequence and intended duplicates.
Fixtures include repeated form widgets, annotations, outlines, attachments and rotated pages; unsupported transformations fail before replacing review.
Render/export failure leaves the previous prepared PDF printable/downloadable; blocked downloads report useful status.

contracts.feature: Multiple-file page order and worker execution
contracts.observedBehavior: Separate file and thumbnail Sortable flows construct merge jobs; worker imports configured CPDF script and returns success/error through its protocol.
contracts.reuseBoundary: Reuse file/page job structures and UI while binding each source to digest, engine capability and owned worker session.
improvementsAndRisks: Worker receives a runtime script URL; JETT must not silently inherit third-party CDN execution.
Different input documents can share page numbers and filenames; source identity requires more than label/index.
fixtureAcceptance: Merge two PDFs with repeated filenames using unique source IDs and verify requested interleaving.
Wrong-engine URL or worker failure leaves all source documents and previous review unchanged.
Abort invalidates the job; late success cannot open or download a superseded result.
